title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 02 March 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 01 March 2026 Mainly dry weather will prevail in the most parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Southern and North-western provinces and in Anuradhapura and Vavuniya districts during the early hours of the morning.
